Ben (sales): Nora reported POC is intermittently getting 429s on /v1/generate during their concurrent-demo run. Can SRE help triage?
Aisha (sales-eng): please paste a sample curl + response headers so we can see x-rw-* values. Also how many concurrent streams are they opening?
Nora (Acme): sample below, happens under load every ~minute.
Nora (Acme): ```bash
curl -i -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-acme" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-small-rl","input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit: 25;w=1;burst=50
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 8
{"error":{"message":"route capacity exceeded","code":429}}
```
Ben (sales): client says they open ~200 tiny requests concurrently during the demo. Tenant UI shows credits available.
Derek (SRE): reading headers: route cap is 25 r/s with burst 50. Route limiter is blocking - tenant credits don't automatically lift route caps.
Jules (infra): internal route config check: `GET /admin/routes/r-acme-default` -> rate_limit {per_second:25, burst:50, mode:"strict"}.
Aisha (sales-eng): short-term options: (A) bump per-route to 200/500 for 2h, (B) enable reservations mode and allocate from tenant pool, (C) give a manual soft-burst window. Which preferred?
Ben (sales): need demo tonight at 20:00 UTC. Prefer short-term bump to avoid surprise later. Finance should be looped for temporary cost.
Marta (finance): FYI approve temporary cap increase for demo; please log expected usage so we can reconcile.
Derek (SRE): proposing admin patch now. Command: `PATCH /admin/routes/r-acme-default` with rate_limit per_second=200 burst=500 mode="soft" and note.
QuotaBot: route r-acme-default rate_limit change proposed by Derek at 2024-09-11T18:05:00Z (per_second:25->200, burst:50->500). Reply YES to confirm within 30m.
Aisha (sales-eng): YES (approve).
Jules (infra): applied change, admin returned 200. New route config active.
Nora (Acme): running validation load 300 concurrent requests for 5m. First 4 minutes showing 0 429s, p95 latency ~180ms. :tada:
Derek (SRE): leaving soft bump for 2 hours; scheduled auto-revert at 20:15 UTC. Added internal ticket to add per-route reservation step to presales checklist.
Ben (sales): create PR for presales automation and tag finance for the billing note. Thanks team, closing thread once follow-ups are filed. :white_check_mark:
